docs.question: How many bike stations are there?
docs.answer: There are 115 bike stations in the dataset.

docs.question: Which station is closest to O'Connell Bridge?
docs.answer: PRINCES STREET / O'CONNELL STREET is the closest station to O'Connell Bridge, about 0.22 km away. The next closest are TOWNSEND STREET (0.34 km) and CUSTOM HOUSE (0.34 km).

docs.question: Which station has spent the most minutes empty?
docs.answer: GRANGEGORMAN LOWER (CENTRAL) has spent the most time empty, at about 407 minutes with no bikes (roughly 62% of the time it was observed). James Street East (352 minutes) and Herbert Street (350 minutes) come next.

docs.question: Which 3 stations have the highest peak-hour shortage rate?
docs.answer: The three highest peak-hour shortage rates are PHIBSBOROUGH ROAD at 100% of its 70.4 observed peak minutes empty, GOLDEN LANE at 70.7% of 64.3 minutes, and PORTOBELLO ROAD at 59.9% of 74.8 minutes. Note that each of these figures rests on just over an hour of peak-hour observations, so they are based on limited data.
docs.sql: SELECT station_name, zone, peak_shortage_rate, peak_observed_minutes FROM marts.mart_station_kpis WHERE peak_observed_minutes > 0 AND peak_shortage_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY peak_shortage_rate DESC LIMIT 3

docs.question: Compare the average number of available bikes in hours with precipitation versus dry hours.
docs.answer: Across hours with observed weather, dry hours averaged 11.84 available bikes (876 hours) versus 11.65 in hours with precipitation (457 hours), a difference of about 0.2 bikes per station-hour. Looking per station, the average rain_bike_delta across the 113 stations that have both wet and dry observations is -0.35 bikes, so rain is associated with slightly fewer available bikes, but the effect is small.
docs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS stations, ROUND(CAST(AVG(rain_bike_delta) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_delta FROM marts.mart_station_kpis WHERE rain_bike_delta IS NOT NULL LIMIT 200
